_doc: Curated golden-query set for the rosetta MCP `routeros_search` surface. See src/eval/retrieval.ts for the runner. Each entry asserts what an agent SHOULD see when it asks this question. `expected_rosetta_ids` lists page rosetta-ids (see src/rosetta-id.ts) that are acceptable as a 'correct' top-N hit (any match counts) — NOT the numeric `pages.id`, which is a fresh rowid re-minted on every extract-docusaurus.ts run and is not a stable identity. `expected_classified` asserts the regex classifier's detection. Keep this set small and high-signal — quality over quantity. Add new entries when you fix a real bug, not speculatively.

queries.query: how do I set up a DHCP server
block traffic from a specific IP address
queries.notes: KNOWN REGRESSION, tracked by T-0038: the real Filter page currently ranks 6th of 10, beaten by incidental short unrelated pages (BM25 length bias and/or AND-fallback fragility — see T-0038). Left pointed at the correct pages deliberately, not loosened, so this keeps failing visibly until fixed.

queries.notes: Classifier MUST detect the path; command_node check skipped on slim DBs.
Classifier captures the patch version when present; exact patch versions must stay exact.
Major.minor version questions should surface changelogs even when the DB stores only patch-version rows.
Classifier currently detects 'hAP' (the family) not 'hAP ax3' (the specific model). Tightening to 'hAP ax3' is a known classifier improvement — see Device AKA backlog item.
#49: a bare product code resolves to its canonical device (hEX) — related.devices must surface.

#49: lowercase www/hardware slug the device regexes miss — the searchAll whole-input alias probe resolves it to cAP ac. No expected_classified (classifier intentionally stays pure/regex; resolution is the alias probe's job).
#49: 'Chateau' family pattern added to the classifier (regexes previously missed it); searchDevices disambiguates the specific model.
Multi-word firewall query. Top-3 should be firewall-related (any of mangle/filter/raw/nat pages).

queries.query: what does the disabled property do
queries.notes: Ambiguous — 'disabled' exists on dozens of pages. Classifier doesn't currently detect 'disabled' as a property name (no strong signal). Tracked as classifier improvement opportunity. This entry currently passes as a no-op; tighten when classifier learns common property names.
